title: PlastFormer scan act (offline consolidation only; read-class)

ids.description: для mode=amplitudes по конкретным записям; иначе физика всего банка

description: Read-class act: no writes, no ticks (C5), no trace deposited. Returns raw substrate physics (amplitudes/ticks/layers) — no scores, no interpretations. Interpretation is the model's own work. Budget governed by the self_improvement master switch (scan <= 32 per consolidation run).
